mainEntity.name: How do I keep AI-generated slides from looking generic, cluttered, or inconsistent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use AI to create a first draft of a deck, then apply a consistent visual system yourself or through a controlled template. Set rules for typography, color, spacing, image treatment, headings, and slide density before generating multiple lessons. Run My AI Biz’s presentation and digital-product examples can fit into a broader content-production workflow, but quality depends on the instructions and revisions. Context: automatic design often produces inconsistent layouts, crowded slides, or decorative visuals that do not help comprehension. Key factors: brand guidelines, audience, screen size, delivery setting, visual complexity, and editable output. Practical guidance: approve one sample slide family before generating the full presentation. Remove repeated text from slides and place explanations in speaker notes or a handout. Review the deck at presentation distance, not only on a detailed monitor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Create a visual system first: fonts, colors, spacing, image rules, headings, and slide density. Test one sample section, approve the template, then generate more and remove text that belongs in notes.
